name: Citadel Outlets
description: Citadel Outlets is Los Angeles' premier outlet shopping destination featuring over 130 global brand stores and restaurants housed in a distinctive Assyrian palace-inspired architectural design. Located just minutes from downtown LA, LAX, and major Southern California attractions, this open-air center offers shoppers exceptional deals on luxury and premium brands including Coach, Michael Kors, Nike, lululemon, The North Face, and Marc Jacobs.
summary: Los Angeles' leading outlet shopping center featuring over 130 global brands in a unique Assyrian palace-inspired setting, minutes from downtown LA and major attractions.
